Private Sub Edit(ByVal which As Long, c As Object, r As Variant)
    Select Case which
    Case 1: c.SeriesCollection.NewSeries: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 2: c.SeriesCollection.NewSeries: c.SeriesCollection.NewSeries: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 3: With c.SeriesCollection.NewSeries: .Name = "=One!$A$1": .Values = "=One!$B$2:$C$2": End With: r = c.SeriesCollection(3).Formula
    Case 4: c.SeriesCollection(2).Delete: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 5: c.SeriesCollection(1).Delete: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 6: c.SeriesCollection(1).Delete: c.SeriesCollection.NewSeries: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 7: c.SeriesCollection.NewSeries: c.SeriesCollection(3).Delete: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 8: c.SetSourceData c.Parent.Parent.Range("A1:C3"): r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 9: c.SetSourceData c.Parent.Parent.Range("A1:B3"): r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 10: c.SetSourceData c.Parent.Parent.Range("A1:C3"), xlColumns: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 11: c.PlotBy = xlColumns: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 12: c.SeriesCollection(1).Values = "=One!$B$3:$C$3": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 13: c.SeriesCollection(1).XValues = "=One!$A$2:$A$3": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 14: c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula = "=SERIES(One!$A$3,One!$B$1:$C$1,One!$B$3:$C$3,1)": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 15: c.ChartType = xlLine: r = c.ChartType
    Case 16: c.ChartType = xlLineMarkers: r = c.ChartType
    Case 17: c.ChartType = xlBarClustered: r = c.ChartType
    Case 18: c.ChartType = xlColumnStacked: r = c.ChartType
    Case 19: c.ChartType = xlArea: r = c.ChartType
    Case 20: c.ChartType = xlPie: r = c.ChartType
    Case 21: c.ChartType = xlLine: c.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: r = c.ChartType
    Case 22: c.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: r = c.ChartType
    Case 23: c.SeriesCollection(2).ChartType = xlLine: r = c.SeriesCollection(2).ChartType
    End Select
End Sub

Public Function Act(ByVal path As String, ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, c As Object, r As Variant, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set c = wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart
    On Error Resume Next
    Edit which, c, r
    s = Err.Number & " " & TypeName(r) & " " & r
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs out, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    wb.Close False
    Act = s
End Function

c.ChartType = xlLine: c.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: r = c.ChartType
